notes:
I can't give you the Psalm 92 notes yet, because I haven't managed to read any of the source pages.

I tried to open six pages at once: Enduring Word on Psalm 92, the Bible Hub commentary page for Psalm 92:1, Augustine's exposition on New Advent, the NET Bible notes, Gill on StudyLight, and Precept Austin. A coding mistake meant I never saw what came back, so I don't know which pages loaded. After that the tool wouldn't let me make any more requests in this turn.

Your rules say to report only what the pages actually say and never fill gaps from my own knowledge. Since I haven't read any of them, I've left the verse-by-verse notes out rather than write them from memory.

**Next steps:** If you ask again, I'll start from those same pages and then add more:
- **Traditional readings:** Enduring Word; Bible Hub (Gill, Ellicott, Pulpit, Barnes and others); StudyLight; Precept Austin; Spurgeon's *Treasury of David*.
- **Protestant differences:** Wesley's notes (wesley.nnu.edu); Reformed and Lutheran sources on the Sabbath title (v. 1) and the "anointed / horn" lines (v. 10).
- **Other views:** NET Bible notes; Augustine and other Church Fathers on New Advent (most of them number this psalm 91); Catholic Answers; OCA; any discussion of the "flourish like a palm tree" verses (vv. 12–14) in prosperity teaching.

To make it more likely to work, I can do it in smaller batches, for example verses 1–5 first. Just say "continue."
